info.title: Dev Health Auth Control Plane v1
info.summary: Wire contract for the Go Auth Control Plane service.
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Auth Control Plane v1 wire surface.

WHY 3.1 AND NOT 3.0: OpenAPI 3.1 uses JSON Schema draft 2020-12 as its schema dialect directly, so the `$ref`s below point at the SAME schema files the Go, Python and TypeScript validators read. OpenAPI 3.0 uses a modified subset of draft-04 and would have required a second, translated copy of every schema -- and two copies of one contract is the drift class the cross-language golden fixtures exist to catch.

WHY JSON AND NOT YAML: this document is validated by three runtimes. JSON needs no parser beyond the one each already has; YAML would add a parser dependency to the Go and TypeScript sides purely for the sake of convention, and a document that is harder to check is not a better contract.

PATHS: the four session routes auth-service mounts when its session secrets are set (CHAOS-10228): POST /v1/token/refresh, GET /v1/sessions/current, POST /v1/sessions/revoke and POST /v1/sessions/revoke-all. With neither secret set the service mounts no route and answers 404 everywhere. Each path has a row in contracts/auth/v1/endpoint-profiles.auth-service.json; the paths of later routes land with those routes.

post.description: The provider access token in the body is verified with the provider (issued to this service's OAuth client, email verified) and the link is bound to the bearer's principal. A sign-in older than the freshness window is refused (403); an identity bound to another principal is a conflict (409) and nothing is written.
